comments.comment: readHeader parses a note's YAML header by hand beside a yaml dependency, and the gap its comment states is one nothing in the repository supports.
comments.failureScenario: A note opens with a header whose title line is `title: "Plans: 2027"`. title() in src/cli.ts calls readHeader, which returns the title with its quotation marks kept, `"Plans: 2027"`. yaml's parse returns Plans: 2027. The comment says the module runs before the dependencies are installed, but src/cli.ts imports it beside loadConfig, which calls yaml's parse in the same process, and package.json runs no script before install.
